name: What is the standard height for D-shaped handles on cabinet doors?

mainEntity.name: What is the standard height for D-shaped handles on cabinet doors?

acceptedAnswer.text: For upper cabinet doors, D-shaped handles are typically placed on the bottom rail of the door frame, 2-3 inches from the bottom edge. For lower cabinet doors, they are usually installed on the top rail, 2-3 inches from the top edge. The goal is to place them at a comfortable height for opening while maintaining a consistent visual line across your cabinetry. This ensures both functionality and aesthetic appeal.
acceptedAnswer.description: For upper doors, handles are 2-3 inches from the bottom edge; for lower doors, 2-3 inches from the top edge for comfortable access.
